create_runpod_pod: create a RunPod GPU pod with specified name, GPU count, and environment variables via the CLI
terminate_runpod_pod: terminate a RunPod GPU pod by name or pod ID using the RunPod REST API
wait_for_runpod_pod: wait for a named RunPod GPU pod to become available by polling every 10 seconds
get_runpod_pod_id: get the pod ID and status of a named RunPod GPU pod via the REST API
run_create_pod_with_retry: run a RunPod pod creation request with up to 3 retries on 400/500 errors
